Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Brass-Framed Dining Chair, 34"H, Ink
Colors: Ink
Materials: Brass
The curved back of this modern dining chair offers comfortable support. The chair’s simple lines, armless design, and ink-colored upholstery create a versatile piece that can fit into any dining area’s color and decor. A brass base creates a sturdy structure while adding to the chair’s clean style. 20"W x 24"D x 34"H; seat height: 19"H; seat depth: 18"W; seat back height: 15"H 100% polyester fabric on solid wood frame with a brass base Simple, clean contemporary design No assembly required Avoid moisture. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
